description: Proves blocks, transactions, logs and transfers under the Taifoon superroot. For reading chain data without a proof use taifoon_chain. Actions: tx — one transaction inside the superroot (chain, tx); item — anything the superroot commits, by kind: tx, log, receipt, state; block — a block under the superroot (proof.verify.v5); superroot — the current superroot and the chains it includes; transfer — attest a cross-chain CCTP transfer; finality — what a V5 finality type id means.

action.description: what to do (default tx): tx | item | block | superroot | transfer | finality

block_number.description: Block number on that chain (actions: block)

chain_id.description: any chain the layer reads (GET /v1/rpc): 8453, 5042, 1, 56, 43114, 42161, 137, 10, 4663, 42220, 36927, 3692781, 2741, 196, 143, 100; another chain answers 404 chain_not_read (actions: tx, item, block, transfer)

name: taifoon_prove
title: Prove a chain fact
